ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows the outline of a pentagon; it can be seen that it has 5 sides, so the image confirms that the figure is a pentagon. Reasoning: The problem states that this is a regular pentagon, so its 5 interior angles are equal. The formula for the sum of the interior angles of an n-sided polygon is (n−2)×180°. For a pentagon, n=5, so the sum of the interior angles is (5−2)×180°=3×180°=540°. Each interior angle of a regular pentagon is equal, so each interior angle is 540°÷5=108°.
